comment: I enjoyed Prof. Molenkamp's BLaw class. He has a dry sense of humor which helps to break up the often detailed/complicated law material. He has a ton of real-world experience to bring to class discussions which I found insightful. Much better than other reviews make him seem.

I have no idea why everyone gives Prof Molenkamp such a hard time. He tries to make lectures as interesting as possible, it's a dry subject. He's a very knowledgeable guy. The tests are hard but very reasonable. Extra Credit helps a lot. Class really isn't that bad at all.

i did not realize this guys was infamous at the university of richmond until it was too late to drop. he will not prepare you for the extremely difficult exams. this may be the hardest course in the business school as his expectations are outrageous, and his exams are impossible to pass. seriously take anyone else, this class was terrible.

This was the single worst class I've ever taken. Professor Molenkamp is incredibly full of himself and his lectures are boring. His tests are impossible & he thinks that everyone can memorize 600-pages of material. I'd transfer colleges before taking another one of his classes. Sending prayers & condolences to anyone who has to take his class. RIP

Test are completely different from anything you will practice/learn. Says you don't need to write notes during class because he'll give you a study guide, but the study guide is useless. He's a nice and chill guy, but his class is rough.

He is knowledgable about business law and seems like a good guy. The concepts of the class are not difficult by any means, the quizzes are easy. However, once you get to the test, the whole class will get a C or D, with few grades higher than that. I will never understand why some teachers will make tests in low-level classes impossible.
